title: Gnarlspit Splits Again
story: Deep in the Rustbone Desert, a spiky green fiend called Gnarlspit blocks the only well. Every time a sword touches him, he splits into three smaller cactus-fiends — so hacking away is exactly the wrong plan. Mr 6 sheathes his blade and starts counting instead.
question: Gnarlspit starts as 1 cactus. A careless caravan guard struck him 4 times in a row, and each strike turned every cactus present into 3 cacti. How many cacti face Mr 6 after the 4th strike?
hint: Every strike multiplies the whole crowd by 3. Write the count after each strike: 1, then 3, then...
victory: Mr 6 announced '81 — and one more swing makes 243!' The guard froze mid-swing, and Mr 6 simply watered the cacti instead, turning the whole prickly army into a very polite hedge.
imagePrompt: A bristling green cactus monster multiplying into dozens of smaller copies around a desert well at hot golden noon, with a small numeral-6 knight holding up a warning hand.
